messages:
sam: Heads-up — I opened the SDK PR that depends on the API feature flag change. SDK PR: https://git.redwood/rg/sdk/pull/482. It currently fails integration because the API PR isn't merged yet. Can we coordinate merge slots?

maya: 👍 saw it. Which API PR is that?

sam: API PR is https://git.redwood/rg/api/pull/2013 — adds the new /v2/embed batching header and a small behavior change in error codes. SDK uses the header to enable batching.

leon: I can review the API PR today. Heads up there are helm chart tweaks needed in runtime for the header to be forwarded in the LB. That's in a separate PR for eng-runtime/helm: https://git.redwood/rg/helm/pull/77 (draft).

jess: For console: the UI expects the new header to be present for the devtools panel. I have a console PR ready but blocked on API merge too: https://git.redwood/rg/console/pull/309.

sam: TL;DR: API -> helm (runtime) -> SDK + console. Need to align order and avoid half-merged state. Any merge window preferences?

maya: Could we do API + helm in one maintenance window, then SDK/console after smoke tests pass? Suggest maintenance window 14:00–15:30 UTC today.

leon: That works for me but helm PR needs a small lint fix. I'll push in 10m. Can we get 1 reviewer for helm and 1 approver for API?

jess: I can review console once API is merged. I won't be available during the 14:00 UTC slot (calendar conflict). If API + helm go in at 14:00, can someone hold SDK/console merges around 14:30–15:00 so I can do quick QA after 15:00?

sam: @jess noted. We can gate console merge until 15:05. SDK merges can go earlier if tests pass.

maya: I can take API approval. @leon can you ping me once helm's lint fix is pushed?

leon: Pushed lint fix and bumped chart version to 0.12.4. CI shows helm/chart-lint passing locally.

ci-bot: Check report — api/pull/2013: unit ✅, integration ✖ (expected until helm forwarded header). SDK/pull/482: unit ✅, integration ✖. helm/pull/77: lint ✅, chart-tests ✅.

sam: Okay, plan: 14:00 UTC — merge API PR (maya approves), merge helm PR immediately after (leon). Then run smoke tests for 25m. If smoke is green by 14:30, merge SDK PR; hold console until 15:05 for jess QA. If smoke fails, rollback helm and revert API. Sound good?

maya: Sounds good. I'll queue my approval at 13:55 and stay by Slack.

jess: I'll be reachable by phone for a quick look if needed. If I can't check by 15:05, tag @sam to hold the merge.

leon: I'll also watch the runtime deploy. If traffic flagging looks odd, I'll flip canary back.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for runtime chart 0.12.4 at 14:07 UTC (canary window 5m). Monitoring hooks enabled.

ci-bot: Smoke-run started at 14:12 UTC for api+runtime. Current status: 18/20 checks passed, 2 flaky timeouts being retried.

sam: If smoke passes, SDK owners — please be ready to merge with squash + signed commit, and don't change the SDK version number in the PR after merge. We'll bump separately in release pipeline.

maya: API merged at 14:18 UTC. @leon please proceed with helm.

leon: Helm merged at 14:21 UTC. Deploy progressing.

ci-bot: Smoke-run completed at 14:28 UTC: all checks ✅. No regressions detected in prefix caching or KV store.

sam: SDK folks, go ahead.

sam: Merged SDK PR at 14:33 UTC. CI all green.

jess: I did quick QA at 15:03 UTC — console devtools header present and shows batching toggle. All good. Merged console at 15:06 UTC.

sam: Great job everyone. Postmortem notes: one flaky integration test delayed smoke-run by 8 minutes; we should add it to flaky-tests tracking. Also consider a quick runbook for cross-repo feature rollouts (API -> infra -> clients).

maya: I'll open a tiny RFC in eng-platform about rollout sequencing and a checklist for these cross-repo flows.

leon: Filed issue: https://git.redwood/rg/infra/issues/612 — add helm/runtime checklist.

sam: Thanks — closing this thread. :tada:
